title: wolfSSL PKCS7 SignedData signed attributes out-of-bounds write
input_type: crafted PKCS7 SignedData encoding request with oversized custom signed attributes
notes: Candidate selected from wolfSSL official security vulnerability entry and NVD description. Expected root cause: PKCS7 SignedData custom signed attributes exceed fixed signedAttribs[7] capacity due to incorrect capacity passed to EncodeAttributes.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Encoding PKCS7 SignedData with more than 7 custom signed attributes reaches wc_PKCS7_BuildSignedAttributes and can write past fixed signedAttribs[7].
expected_fixed_behavior: wolfSSL v5.9.0-stable rejects or bounds custom signed attributes using availableSpace before EncodeAttributes writes into esd->signedAttribs.
crash_signal: AddressSanitizer stack-buffer-overflow; WRITE of size 8; EncodeAttributes -> wc_PKCS7_BuildSignedAttributes -> wc_PKCS7_EncodeSignedData
fixed_behavior: wc_PKCS7_EncodeSignedData returned -132 with no ASan crash
reproduction_summary: A PKCS7 SignedData encoding request is configured with 8 custom signed attributes. In v5.8.4-stable, wc_PKCS7_BuildSignedAttributes passes the oversized custom attribute list into EncodeAttributes, which writes past the fixed signedAttribs[7] array. In v5.9.0-stable and current, availableSpace validation rejects the oversized attribute list before the out-of-bounds write.
